title: HungerStation stores
subtitle: Stores onboarded on the direct HungerStation rail, their chain and vendor id, and how their stock sync is doing.

access.deniedHint: Your account does not hold the HungerStation stores grant. Ask an administrator if you need it.
access.unreachableHint: Your access could not be checked, so this screen stays closed. Try again in a moment.

filters.qPlaceholder: Store code, name or vendor id

health.failingHint: The newest push in the last 24 hours failed.
health.silentHint: This active store sent no push in the last 24 hours.

results.failedTitle: The stores could not be loaded

chain.fallbackHint: The chain list could not be read. Type the chain key; a wrong key is refused.

onboard.title: Onboard a HungerStation store
onboard.note: The store's HungerStation orders are matched by its vendor id, and its stock starts flowing to HungerStation. A store whose onboarding was removed comes back on the chain and vendor id given here.

edit.title: Edit a HungerStation store
edit.note: Correct the chain or vendor id of store <store>{{store}}</store>. Its orders are matched by the new vendor id from now on.
edit.unchanged: Change the chain or the vendor id first.
edit.gone: This store is no longer onboarded
edit.goneHint: It was removed meanwhile. The list has been refreshed.

remove.title: Remove a store's onboarding
remove.note: Remove the HungerStation onboarding of store <store>{{store}}</store>.

consequences.syncStops: Its stock sync stops and its orders are no longer fetched.
consequences.vendorIdFree: Its vendor id becomes free for another store.
consequences.historyStays: Its logs, orders and history stay readable.
consequences.notOffHungerStation: It is not taken off HungerStation: that is done in HungerStation's portal.

remove.revive: To bring it back, onboard the same store code again.
remove.doneDetail: Store {{store}} is no longer onboarded on HungerStation.
remove.gone: This store is no longer onboarded
remove.goneHint: It was already removed, or never onboarded. The list has been refreshed.

pause.title: Pause a store's stock sync
pause.note: Pause the stock sync of store <store>{{store}}</store>. No stock is pushed to HungerStation until it is resumed.
pause.doneDetail: Store {{store}}: its stock is no longer pushed to HungerStation.
pause.gone: This store is no longer onboarded
pause.goneHint: It was removed meanwhile. The list has been refreshed.

resume.title: Resume a store's stock sync
resume.note: Resume the stock sync of store <store>{{store}}</store>. The scheduled pushes send its stock to HungerStation again.
resume.doneDetail: Store {{store}}: its stock is pushed to HungerStation again.
resume.gone: This store is no longer onboarded
resume.goneHint: It was removed meanwhile. The list has been refreshed.

syncNow.pausedHint: The stock sync is paused. Resume it first.
syncNow.title: Push a store's stock now
syncNow.note: This is a full push of store <store>{{store}}</store>'s stock to the live HungerStation vendor <vendor>{{vendorId}}</vendor>, now. Every material is sent, not only the changes.
syncNow.doneDetail: Store {{store}}: the full push is recorded.

refusal.paused: The stock sync of this store is paused.
refusal.pausedHint: Resume it first, then push. The list has been refreshed.
refusal.hungerStationFailed: HungerStation refused the push or could not be reached.
refusal.hungerStationFailedHint: The push was recorded as failed: it appears in the store's logs. HungerStation's answer:
refusal.busy: A push is already running; try again shortly.
refusal.busyHint: Another push of this store is running right now. Nothing was pushed or recorded.
refusal.gone: This store is no longer onboarded
refusal.goneHint: It was removed meanwhile. The list has been refreshed.

logs.hint: Newest first, the last {{days}} days (at most {{max}} pushes).
logs.failed: The pushes could not be loaded
logs.empty: No push was recorded for this store in the last {{days}} days.
logs.unknownStore: No HungerStation store and no push is recorded for this store code.

lines.hint: A push's lines are kept for {{days}} days.
lines.expired: This push's detail is no longer here: push detail is kept for {{days}} days.
lines.failed: The lines could not be loaded
lines.noMatch: No line of this push matches that material number.

material.hint: Every line sent for one material at this store in the last {{days}} days, newest first (at most {{max}}).
material.prompt: Type a material number to see what HungerStation was sent for it at this store.
material.failed: The material's history could not be loaded
material.empty: Material <m>{{material}}</m> was not sent to this store in the last {{days}} days.
material.capped: Only the newest {{max}} lines are shown; older lines from the last {{days}} days are not.

reason.label: Reason
reason.hint: Required. It is kept with the change.
